purpose: Directly read semantic topic comparators supplement weak lexical nearest matches. No key, audit or verdict copied.

records.stem: The Manager of Record of a Massachusetts retail pharmacy plans a six-week medical leave. The dates are known in advance. Which steps are required for this planned absence under 247 CMR 9.23? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Appoint a Board-registered Interim Manager before the planned absence begins.
Have the Manager of Record perform a controlled-substance inventory before leaving, signed by the Manager of Record and Interim Manager.
Wait five days after the leave begins before deciding whether an Interim Manager is needed.
Immediately file a permanent change-of-Manager application solely because the planned leave exceeds 30 days.
Allow the pharmacy to operate without a designated interim manager as long as another pharmacist is on each shift.

records.stem: A Board inspector asks a Massachusetts Manager of Record for written descriptions of the duties delegated to the pharmacy's technicians and their scopes of responsibility. The Manager of Record has never filed such documents with the Board. What is the correct position?

choices.text: The documents were required to be filed with the Board in advance and the omission is a violation.
No such documents are required in a retail setting.
The documents are required only for certified pharmacy technicians.
The documents must be made available to the Board on request, so they must be produced now.
The documents are required only if the pharmacy uses on-the-job training.

records.stem: Three Massachusetts-licensed pharmacies are closing on the same date: a non-resident Drug Store pharmacy, a resident sterile compounding pharmacy, and an institutional sterile compounding pharmacy. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Each must give the Board certified written notice at least 14 days before closing.
The non-resident pharmacy must make the post-closure submission of original licences.
The sterile compounding pharmacy must identify a pharmacy able to continue patient care.
The institutional sterile compounding pharmacy is excused from the patient-notice duty.
The continuity-of-care pharmacy identified must be licensed by the Board.

records.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy's Manager of Record is leaving amicably at the end of the month and a successor has been identified. Which statements about the change of Manager of Record application are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The inventory attestation is signed by both the outgoing and the incoming Manager.
The inventory covers Schedules II through V and reportable Schedule VI substances.
A staff pharmacist may sign in place of the outgoing Manager for convenience.
A certified copy of the Drug Store Pharmacy licence accompanies the application.
The Board may require the proposed Manager of Record to appear before it.
